name: simulationist
summary: A player who cares about time, distance, equipment, weather and whether an action is physically feasible.
special: Ask what time it is, how long something takes and how far away it is, before committing.
Say what you are carrying and what you would need; ask to buy or fetch what you lack.
Notice when the world's physical or social logic does not hold -- a shop open at night, a journey that took no time.

natural_investigator.concept: a physician who keeps a careful log
natural_investigator.creation_brief: A physician. Strong Medicine, First Aid, Science (Biology), Spot Hidden.

probes: the time spine and whether the clock moves
